title: Syrian Kabocha Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew made with kabocha squash, inspired by the flavors of Syria. The velvety texture of the squash pairs perfectly with the spices and the yellow color adds a pop of brightness to the dish.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the kabocha squash and yellow bell pepper and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the squash is tender, about 20-25 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
